it marks two years since i lost my previous partner to suicide... two years. and somehow, those words still don't feel real

i'm sad, i'm broken, i'm lonely and there are days when i still struggle to comprehend how someone who was once such a big part of my life is no longer here. people often talk about grief as something that gets easier with time but i think some losses simply change you forever. you learn to live with the absence, but that doesn't mean you stop feeling it

today i want to talk about something that deserves so much more attention: suicide prevention

behind every statistic is a person. someone who was loved, someone who mattered, someone whose absence leaves a hole in the lives of people who remain, someone who could still be here. suicide doesn't just take one life, it leaves countless people trying to make sense of a loss that is often impossible to put into words

please check on the people around you. even the ones who seem happy, the ones who laugh, the ones who say they're fine or the ones you think would never ever end up like this. listen without judgement. make space for difficult conversations. don't dismiss someone's pain or assume that because they seem okay, they are okay

and if you're struggling yourself, please know that you don't have to reach breaking point to deserve help. you are not a burden, your feelings matter, you are valid and and there is no shame in asking someone to stay or help you find support at any time you feel like you need it

i wish things had been different. i wish this anniversary was just another ordinary day. i wish there were more conversations, more awareness, more support and fewer families and friends having to experience this kind of heartbreak

two years later, i still miss you and i still love you. and i hope that by speaking about this, even one person might feel less alone and choose to stay!!

for my American friends, call or text 988 or chat 988lifeline.org. you can also reach Crisis Text Line by texting HOME to 741741, or call 911, or go to the nearest emergency room

for my UK mates, Samaritans are available 24/7 at 116 123 or text "SHOUT" to 85258
